goal: Create a buildable multi-project workspace with the three CSCI skeletons in their selected product forms.
notes: Acceptance Criteria: 1. `swift test --package-path AirframeCore` passes. 2. `swift test --package-path AICockpit` passes. 3. `swift run --package-path AICockpit aicockpit --help` prints deterministic help. 4. `xcodebuild -workspace Airframe.xcworkspace -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' build` succeeds. 5. AgileCockpit and AICockpit both import AirframeCore.
rationale: All later work depends on a stable workspace, package, app, and test baseline that can be verified from a clean checkout.
scope: Establish baseline build and test commands.
